question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guide path: 6.7 (Q4FY26), 7.7, 8.5, 9.2 (Q3FY27); increments +0.7 to +1.0 recently. CFO said FY27 opex now expected to grow 'low 50s'; FY26 GAAP opex ~23.08B and Q1+Q2 actual+Q3 guide ~25.23B imply Q4 ~9.6-10.1B (similar on non-GAAP basis adding ~0.2B gap). Guidance was already raised once ('now expect'), and Q4 guides historically step up more, so slight upward skew. No prediction market found (Polymarket/Manifold per harness; Kalshi search found none).
calls.dossier:
- Q3 FY27 outlook (Q2 FY27 PR, 2026-08-26): GAAP opex ~$9.2B, non-GAAP ~$9.0B; revenue $108B ±2%.
- Q2 FY27 actual GAAP opex $8.408B (guide was ~$8.5B); Q1 FY27 actual $7.621B (guide ~$7.7B, incl. $1.9B SBC; NVIDIA non-GAAP now includes SBC, GAAP/non-GAAP gap ~$0.2B). Source: Q1 and Q2 FY27 press releases (SEC/nvidianews).
- Q4 FY26 actual GAAP opex $6.794B; FY26 GAAP opex by quarter ≈ 5.03, 5.41, 5.84, 6.79 = ~$23.08B (Q2 FY26 = 5.413 per Q2 FY27 PR).
- GAAP opex guide history: Q1FY26 5.2, Q2FY26 5.7, Q3FY26 5.9, Q4FY26 6.7, Q1FY27 7.7, Q2FY27 8.5, Q3FY27 9.2 (increments +0.5,+0.2,+0.8,+1.0,+0.8,+0.7).
- Q2 FY27 call (Kress, 2026-08-26; Motley Fool transcript): 'for full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s' driven by broader product portfolio and AI tool usage; basis (GAAP vs non-GAAP) not explicitly stated. 'now' implies an upward revision from prior full-year comment.
- Arithmetic: GAAP FY26 ~23.08B x 1.51-1.53 = 34.85-35.31B; minus Q1+Q2 actual + Q3 guide (25.23B) => implied Q4 GAAP ~9.6-10.1B. Non-GAAP basis (FY26 restated ~22.6B est.) gives Q4 non-GAAP ~9.5-10.0 => GAAP ~9.7-10.2. Q3 actual may come in ~0.1B under guide, shifting implied Q4 up slightly.
- Q2 opex growth drivers: compute infrastructure and compensation/benefits; up 10% seq GAAP, 55% YoY.
- Status quo: NVIDIA always gives single 'approximately $X billion' GAAP opex figure in Outlook; resolves off that figure rounded to 0.1B.
- Resolution: resolves off Q3 FY27 press release 'Outlook' GAAP opex figure (for Q4 FY27), not non-GAAP, not call commentary. Expected release 2026-11-17.
- Event window: single release on ~2026-11-17; as of 2026-10-29 the release has not occurred.
- Searched, not found: analyst consensus for Q4 FY27 opex; Q1 FY27 full-year opex growth statement wording; any prediction market (Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold) on this item.

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guides went 6.7, 7.7, 8.5, 9.2 ($B), each set ~0.8-0.9B above the prior quarter's actual. Q3 actual is likely ~9.1B, so the step pattern gives ~9.9-10.0B. The CFO's FY27 'low 50s' opex growth (raised from upper 40s) implies a Q4 GAAP guide of ~9.6-9.95B on a GAAP base. On a non-GAAP-with-SBC base (~22.87B, using the ~0.05B/qtr FY26 gap) it implies ~10.05-10.3B. Median 10.0B. Small low tail if Q3 underruns its guide a lot; small high tail from acquisition costs (Groq). No market found.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) whether the FY26 restated non-GAAP base is ~22.4-22.5 (Run 2) or ~22.75 (Run 3). Run 3's dossier gives Q2FY26 recast non-GAAP 5.361 vs GAAP 5.413, a ~0.05B quarterly gap, which puts the base near 22.87. That rejects Run 2's low non-GAAP implication and pushes the non-GAAP reading up to ~10.05-10.3 GAAP. (2) Whether 'low 50s' is on a GAAP or non-GAAP basis: unsettled, so both readings are weighted. (3) Whether the August wording was 'now' or 'continue to': two sources point to a raise from upper forties, so a mild upward tilt. Combining the GAAP-basis arithmetic (~9.6-9.95), the non-GAAP-basis arithmetic (~10.05-10.3) and the step pattern (~9.9-10.0) puts the median at 10.0. No web access on this run.
